status: domain and import contract design; not a parser, SQL migration, registered AI tool or executed import

sourceRecord.retention: preserve original content and source context; derived extraction and mapping are versioned

normalization.unknown: retain unknown values and raw source; do not substitute zero or an arbitrary unit
normalization.formulas: retain formula and cached/displayed value when available; absent or stale computed values require a suitable reader or clarification, not execution of embedded code
normalization.units: devices, channels, sets, packages and cable length are separate quantities; conversions require an explicit basis
normalization.sourceNegatives: preserve negative source values as adjustment/issue candidates rather than treating them as installed device counts
normalization.modelMatching: use manufacturer, exact model/order code, variant and market with evidence; an alias or visual resemblance alone is insufficient
normalization.unmatchedProduct: retain a custom product and source, with incomplete capability state; no fabricated geometry or protocol compatibility

relationships: one product definition can have multiple versioned room allocations
one physical device can expose multiple channels or control entities
one kit can contain devices and accessories; do not count both as independent duplicate procurement quantities
one BOM row can remain unplaced or allocate to multiple planned device instances
design, quotation, procurement and installed records retain their own roles and correspondence
planned, unplaced and spare quantities do not become arbitrary model instances at the origin

preconditions: current project and target BOM revision
available normalized values and declared unresolved issues
adoption.idempotency: replaying the same adoption operation and source rows into the same target does not add quantities twice; distinct source contexts and room allocations remain explicit
adoption.newSourceRevision: compare changed, added and absent rows; source absence alone does not silently delete adopted project data
adoption.writes: use the project service and a recoverable revision; preserve previous adopted data and manual project additions
adoption.criticalAmbiguity: ask only for missing conditions that block the current action; process independent clear items within existing authorization
adoption.cancelOrFailure: retain original files, completed extraction and prior valid project state

plannedAIToolCapabilities: list, search and read project sources with bounded output and locators
extract selected source tables or regions through configured document/vision services
organize display names, categories, tags and project object associations
preview field mapping, product candidates, quantities and differences
adopt authorized BOM edits through the same project service as UI
return source evidence, unresolved issues, revisions and undo/recovery records
toolAuthority: existing project, task and document access services; imported content and paths do not grant access or execution permissions
implementationGaps: native field mapping and review UI
